info.title: Infinite Flight Tracker Live API
info.description: Read-only live aircraft lookup for the Infinite Flight Tracker. Use lookupAircraft with a callsign such as DHL122. If server is omitted, the backend searches all currently available Infinite Flight servers. Data comes from the Infinite Flight Live API and is not simulated.

get.summary: Look up a live Infinite Flight aircraft
get.description: Provide an aircraft/callsign name. Prefer an exact callsign such as DHL122. Returns current live aircraft matches, including aircraft type, livery, route, position, altitude, speed, heading, vertical speed, last report, and connection state.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Use lookup for an AI-friendly aircraft lookup.

parameters.name: aircraft
parameters.description: Aircraft or callsign to find, for example DHL122, THY546, or an Infinite Flight flight ID.

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: Optional Infinite Flight server to search. If omitted, the backend searches all currently available servers.
